title: AUTHOR CANONICAL TRADE FORMULATION MANUAL (ALL 16 DATA POINTS)
instruction: USER DIRECTIVE: Author a comprehensive, permanent Trade Formulation Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) document at 'desk/TRADE_FORMULATION_MANUAL.md' that both zai-desk and atg-exec must follow for every future round and trade formulation.
